comment: * Interface for classes encapsulating a point multiplication algorithm * for ECPoints. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: ECPoint multiply(ECPoint p, BigInteger k)
methods.comment: * Multiplies the ECPoint p by k, i.e. * p is added k times to itself. * @param p The ECPoint to be multiplied. * @param k The factor by which p is multiplied. * @return p multiplied by k.
